structuralVerification.verifierPython:
import fnmatch
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

base = "1a2d35f5940e7b3f316b361557180ce674590c85"
subject = "cfa577addbf33db1fcd3ea0bafa3621194bb9c00"
old_root = b".agro/skills/remote-sandbox"
new_root = b".agro/skills/sandbox"


def blob(revision, path):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", revision + ":" + path])


def tree(revision, path):
    raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-tree", "-rz", revision, "--", path])
    return {entry.split(b"\t", 1)[1].decode(): entry.split(b"\t", 1)[0].decode()
            for entry in raw.split(b"\0") if entry}


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


retargeted_tests = []
for name, count in [("remote-sandbox", 1), ("remote-sandbox-adapters", 1),
                    ("remote-sandbox-suite", 1), ("skill-shell-portability", 0)]:
    path = ".agro/scripts/__tests__/" + name + ".test.ts"
    before, after = blob(base, path), blob(subject, path)
    assert before.count(old_root) == count
    assert before.replace(old_root, new_root) == after
    retargeted_tests.append({"path": path, "oldLiteral": old_root.decode(),
                            "newLiteral": new_root.decode(), "replacementCount": count,
                            "otherBytesIdentical": True, "baseSha256": digest(before),
                            "candidateSha256": digest(after)})

fixtures = []
for name in ["remote-sandbox", "remote-sandbox-suite"]:
    path = ".agro/scripts/__tests__/fixtures/" + name
    before, after = tree(base, path), tree(subject, path)
    assert before == after
    fixtures.extend({"path": key, "treeEntry": value} for key, value in after.items())
assert len(fixtures) == 7

before_tree, after_tree = tree(base, old_root.decode()), tree(subject, new_root.decode())
machinery = [path for path in before_tree
             if any("/" + directory + "/" in path for directory in ["adapters", "checks", "scripts"])]
assert len(machinery) == 16
for path in machinery:
    assert before_tree[path] == after_tree[path.replace(old_root.decode(), new_root.decode())]

links = []
for path in [".agents/skills", ".claude/skills"]:
    assert tree(base, path) == tree(subject, path)
    entry = tree(subject, path)[path]
    assert entry.startswith("120000 blob ")
    assert blob(subject, path) == b"../.agro/skills"
    links.append({"path": path, "mode": "120000", "target": "../.agro/skills"})
retired = [".agro/skills/hands", old_root.decode()]
for path in retired:
    assert not tree(subject, path)

manifest_path = ".agro/manifest.json"
assert blob(base, manifest_path) == blob(subject, manifest_path)
manifest = json.loads(blob(subject, manifest_path))
assert "skills/**" in manifest["include"] and len(after_tree) == 24
for path in after_tree:
    relative = path[len(".agro/"):]
    assert any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(relative, pattern) for pattern in manifest["include"])
    assert not any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(relative, pattern) for pattern in manifest["exclude"])

workflow_path = ".github/workflows/ci-harness.yml"
before, workflow = blob(base, workflow_path), blob(subject, workflow_path)
assert before.count(old_root) == 3 and before.replace(old_root, new_root) == workflow
text = workflow.decode()
push = text.split("\n  push:\n", 1)[1].split("\n  pull_request:", 1)[0]
pr = text.split("\n  pull_request:\n", 1)[1].split("\nconcurrency:", 1)[0]
for section in [push, pr]:
    assert "      - \".agro/**\"" in section
    assert "!" not in section
command = next(line.strip() for line in text.splitlines()
               if line.strip().startswith("shellcheck -S warning "))
assert old_root.decode() not in command
ci_targets = {}
for directory, count in [("adapters", 4), ("checks", 8), ("scripts", 4)]:
    pattern = ".agro/skills/sandbox/" + directory + "/*.sh"
    assert command.split().count(pattern) == 1
    paths = [path for path in after_tree if fnmatch.fnmatchcase(path, pattern)]
    assert len(paths) == count
    ci_targets[pattern] = paths

package = json.loads(blob(subject, "package.json"))
assert package["scripts"]["test:scripts"] == "vitest run"
assert "run: pnpm test:scripts" in text
assert "\".agro/scripts/__tests__/**/*.test.{ts,mjs}\"" in blob(subject, "vitest.config.ts").decode()

driver = blob(subject, ".agro/scripts/__tests__/remote-sandbox.test.ts").decode()
assert "const SOURCE = join(ROOT, \".agro/skills/sandbox/scripts\");" in driver
assert "for (const file of [\"lib.sh\", \"run.sh\"])" in driver
assert "copyFileSync(join(SOURCE, file), join(skill, \"scripts\", file));" in driver
assert "spawn(\"bash\", [skill.runSh, ...args]" in driver
adapter = blob(subject, ".agro/scripts/__tests__/remote-sandbox-adapters.test.ts").decode()
assert "const LIB = join(ROOT, \".agro/skills/sandbox/scripts/lib.sh\");" in adapter
assert r"""`. "$1"\n${script}`, "bash", LIB""" in adapter
suite = blob(subject, ".agro/scripts/__tests__/remote-sandbox-suite.test.ts").decode()
assert "const SKILL = join(ROOT, \".agro/skills/sandbox\");" in suite
for binding in ["join(SKILL, \"checks/fresh-install.sh\")", "join(SKILL, \"checks/msb-guest.sh\")",
                "copyFileSync(join(SKILL, \"scripts\", file)", "join(skill, \"scripts/restart-test.sh\")"]:
    assert binding in suite

print(json.dumps({
    "schemaVersion": 1, "baseCommit": base, "subjectCommit": subject,
    "method": "Executed whole-file byte comparisons after enumerated path-only substitutions; no assertion, comment or whitespace removal.",
    "activeTestRetargeting": retargeted_tests,
    "unchangedRemoteFixtures": fixtures,
    "activeBindings": {
        "driver": "Canonical lib.sh/run.sh bytes copied into isolated fixtures, then spawned as Bash.",
        "adapters": "Canonical lib.sh sourced by the test wrapper.",
        "suite": "Canonical fresh-install/msb checks and restart scripts read, executed or copied by existing tests.",
        "ci": "pnpm test:scripts maps to vitest run; its include glob selects the remote test modules."
    },
    "ciWorkflow": {"path": workflow_path, "replacementCount": 3,
                   "otherBytesIdentical": True, "baseSha256": digest(before),
                   "candidateSha256": digest(workflow), "pushAndPrInclude": ".agro/**",
                   "negativePathPatterns": 0, "sandboxShellcheckTargets": ci_targets},
    "providerLinks": links, "retiredTreesAbsent": retired,
    "payload": {"manifestUnchanged": True, "include": "skills/**",
                "includedSandboxFiles": 24, "excludedSandboxFiles": 0},
    "preservedMachineryFiles": 16,
    "limits": ["Structural verification only; test execution is separately recorded.",
               "Whole-file equality preserves all existing failure/cleanup test logic, not proof of live resource deletion.",
               "No production source files are bundled into this evidence or substituted for source inspection."]
}, indent=2))
